text:
carmen_fin: EdgeChannel flagged a pricing band discrepancy on their April marketplace settlement. They say the invoice used the mid-tier rate instead of the higher commit-tier they qualify for, netting them a $12,480 short payment. Can billing confirm?

leo_billing: pulling the marketplace and reseller settlement files now. Do we have the partner invoice id?

carmen_fin: invoice EC-APR-26-311. Partner pasted this line in portal: `sku,period,units,reported_band\nredwood-inference.standard,2026-04,4160,enterprise-75k` — they claim our ledger used band `mid-25k` instead.

marta_partners: tagging in. EdgeChannel updated their commit on Mar 28 to 75k yearly, which should put them in the enterprise band for April. We confirmed the commit change in the partner portal.

infra-bot: deploy: marketplace-sync v4.2.0 deployed 2026-03-30T23:58:10Z by deploy-bot.

leo_billing: raw marketplace report shows settlement_band=enterprise-75k for the partner. Our ingestion output for the reseller_payable CSV shows settlement_band=mid-25k. Import log includes "warn: band_map miss for partner_id=ec-01 -> defaulted to mid-25k".

carmen_fin: why did mapping default? That will materially change the per-unit rate. What's the delta per unit?

leo_billing: enterprise unit rate = $3.00, mid-tier = $1.00 for that SKU in April (post-discounts). Their units = 4,160. Differential = $2.00 * 4,160 = $8,320. Hmm — where'd $12,480 come from?

marta_partners: partner included additional add-on units (private cluster premium) 1,080 units at delta $4.00 if misbanded, 1,080 * 4 = $4,320. Sum = $8,320 + $4,320 = $12,640. Partner's note says $12,480 (possible rounding/tax). We'll reconcile the exact amount after we retrieve full CSVs.

leo_billing: pulling both files now. Looks like the marketplace-sync job uses a zone->region mapping that was updated in v4.2.0. The band mapping step joins on partner_commit_id and partner_region. For EdgeChannel their partner_commit_id is present, but region normalized from `us-east-1` to `us-east` by the new job, leading to a failed join and fallback to default band.

carmen_fin: so the sync normalized region strings; the join failed and defaulted. That's an ops regression.

infra-bot: deploy-note: marketplace-sync v4.2.0 changed region normalization to use short codes; rollback option available.

leo_billing: impact summary: 1) Partner settlement used incorrect band causing $12,640 discrepancy (pre-tax). 2) Ledger imported wrong payable and we already sent that ledger file to treasury for payout.

sam_treasury: hold payouts for EdgeChannel until we confirm correction. Pre-approve provisional reversal of the payout if needed. Give me the corrected GL impact.

leo_billing: corrected payable delta: debit 4302 (reseller payables) $12,640, credit 4010 (COGS adjustments) $12,640. We'll produce a corrected invoice for the partner and a reversing journal for the erroneous payout if already processed.

marta_partners: partner prefers a corrected invoice + short payment on our side rather than a credit note. They want explanation and the delta applied before next AP run.

carmen_fin: action items: (1) re-run marketplace-sync for EdgeChannel with region mapping preserved, (2) regenerate reseller_payable CSV and re-import to ledger, (3) produce corrected invoice EC-APR-26-311-rev1, (4) notify treasury and EdgeChannel, (5) post RCA.

leo_billing: I'll do the re-run and backfill. Proposed immediate remediation: backfill import id s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/2026-04-ec-edgechannel-recalc.csv (I'll post object id when finished). Also we'll tag the ingestion rule to prefer exact region matches for partner joins.

infra-bot: rollback available: marketplace-sync v4.2.0 -> v4.1.7. Recommend a hotfix to the join logic instead of full rollback.

sam_treasury: if payout has already been wired, we'll need a reversing entry and then process a top-up payment to partner. Hold funds and let me know ASAP.

leo_billing: backfill complete. import file s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/2026-04-ec-edgechannel-recalc.csv import id imp-2026-04-18-9003. Delta confirmed $12,640. I created FIN-3622 "EdgeChannel: pricing band misclassification Apr — regen & pay adj" and attached corrected invoice draft.

marta_partners: messaged EdgeChannel: "We found an internal normalization bug that misjoined your commit band. We're issuing corrected invoice EC-APR-26-311-rev1 for $12,640 net adjustment and will expedite payment/top-up if needed. Apologies for the disruption." They acknowledged.

carmen_fin: RCA summary for FIN-3622: marketplace-sync v4.2.0 changed region normalization causing failed join on partner_commit_id+region; ingestion defaulted to mid-tier band. Impact: one partner settlement misbanded for April -> $12,640 payable delta. Remediation: re-run per-partner backfill, corrected ledger import, hotfix to preserve full region strings in join logic, added unit test and integration test for partner_commit + region joins, added alert on band_map miss rate >0.5%.

sam_treasury: treasury note: if original payout already processed we will create reversing journal and schedule a top-up payment in next AP run. FIN-3622 marked approved for payout adjustment.

leo_billing: will attach final invoices and the backfill import receipt to FIN-3622 and request controller sign-off on GL entries before month-end close.

carmen_fin: thanks everyone. leaving thread open until controller sign-off and payment confirmation. :white_check_mark:
